verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a SaaS financial-planning product like cfo.ai, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, storage regions, or any region selection. The docs cover integrations, MCP access, OAuth and changelogs, none of which address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
